# Usman Ramzan

Muhammad Usman Ramzan is a Lahore-based fractional CTO, DevOps consultant, and AI-agent engineering consultant working with B2B SaaS teams through URN Labs.

## Consulting through URN Labs
- Organization: URN Labs, https://urnlabs.com/
- Contact: hello@urnlabs.com
- Engagements: ongoing fractional CTO advisory, focused DevOps and platform engineering, and scoped AI-agent engineering projects.
- AI-agent work covers workflow design, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, and approval boundaries. The agentic engineering article is a practical design approach, not a claimed client deployment.
- Request a 30-minute introductory call at https://usmanramzan.com/work-with-me/#call-request. Times are coordinated by email; the site does not provide live calendar booking.
- Pricing is scoped per engagement; start dates are confirmed after reviewing scope and current commitments.

## Background and selected work
- Seven years in cloud infrastructure, spanning cloud consulting, messaging, and enterprise platforms.
- Earlier infrastructure work includes ~40 applications moved from AWS EKS to OCI OKE without customer-facing downtime and $15–20K monthly cloud savings.
- Four anonymized fractional engagements: healthcare security readiness, a travel knowledge assistant, manufacturing data remediation, and media AWS/EKS operations.
- BS Computer Science, FAST-NUCES (2019). CKAD certified.
- Public recommendations from former collaborators are excerpted on the homepage, with source links. They are not identified as consulting-client testimonials.
